---
title: "Using Venv for Virtual Environments"
subtitle: "How to use Venv like Conda from our tutorials"
---

This tutorial shows how to:  
1. Make a venv virtual environment (from terminal and in positron)  
2. How to deactivate and activate virtual environment (from terminal and positron)  
3. How to create a requirements.txt from virtual environment
4. How to use requirements.txt to set the packages/versions in a venv
